01 / TEACH THE NETWORK

Training studio

Paste an ASCII text corpus or load a .txt file. Nova learns to predict each next character from the preceding eight characters. It starts with random weights.

— bytes
1–25 epochs · 9–100,000 ASCII bytes per training run. More text takes longer, especially on phones.
No active training session.0%

Weights are saved automatically after each epoch and when you stop. Saving and resetting affect only Neural Nova's separate experimental app data. Optimizer momentum starts fresh when the app reopens.

02 / PROBE THE BRAIN

Test Nova

Type a prompt to illuminate the input and hidden neurons. Generate text to test the model's next-character predictions, not its conversational understanding.

Generated output will appear here.

This first-stage model is a fixed eight-character-context feed-forward predictor. It is not a Transformer or a fully conversational LLM yet. Expect nonsense until it's trained—and potentially some afterward.

CONTROL / EXPERIMENTAL ONLY

Reset neural weights

Reinitializes the model and deletes its experimental checkpoint. This cannot change original Nova or its data.
